LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.General.RestartNotice: Ordered Work (Core) - changes apply on restart.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.General.AutoRecommend: On: new/default colonies and new pawns get a skill recommendation applied. Off: copy the current vanilla order instead; the top Recommend button still works.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.General.AutoHideScrol: Show Work Control scrollbars only while hovering or scrolling, so the matrix keeps its space.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.General.KeepDestroyed: Off: remove the pawn entry when the game no longer remembers it. On: keep it for mods that can return fully deleted pawns.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.General.PaletteStress: Adds 60 visual-only WorkTypes to test the palette focus.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.General.SpikeInfo: WorkGiver order spike: reorders Hauling WorkGivers for one selected pawn only. No defs are changed.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.General.SpikeToggleTi: When enabled, the spike patch is allowed to reorder the selected pawn's runtime WorkGiver list.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.General.SpikeApply: Apply WorkGiver spike to selected pawn
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.General.SpikeApplyTip: Select exactly one pawn, then reverse that pawn's Hauling WorkGivers and log the result.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.General.SpikeLogTip: Log the selected pawn's current normal and emergency WorkGiver order.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.General.SpikeClearTip: Remove the spike order from the selected pawn.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.General.DenseInfo: Technical spike: writes dense rank 1..N to free colonists and logs the result.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.General.LoadColony: Load a colony to run the dense-rank test.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.General.ResetInfo: Reset the mod configuration without touching pawn 1..N priorities.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.General.ResetConfirmI: This clears orders, splits, merges, colors, stress test and panel height, plus any unsaved drafts. Pawn work priorities are not touched.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.General.BackupWarning: No work type or giver is ever deleted. Back up your save before applying.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.Rules.RestartNotice: Ordered Work (Core) - changes apply on restart.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.Rules.SplitNotice: Split copies work tags, skills, life stages and mech availability.

LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.Rules.ApplyWorkOrderN: No work order changes to apply.

LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.Rules.PrioritizePassi: Prioritize low-level passion over work without skill
When on, a low skill with Minor/Major passion can rank above a WorkType without a relevant skill. When off, only level and naturalPriority decide.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.Rules.PinsInfo: Automatic recommendation pins (top = first). Drag to reorder:
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.Rules.DefaultPinsTip: Default pins: Patient, PatientBedRest, Firefighter. Pins are global and applied in this order before scoring.

LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.Rules.NoDelete: No work type or giver is ever deleted. Back up your save before applying.
LanguageData.OrderedWork.Config.Rules.RestartApply: Split/Merge changes take effect after a restart.
